intro: Double the comfort, double the style—the Ellie dining chairs feature quilted backs and soft upholstery, offering the perfect balance of elegance and ease for your table and your guests.

features.title: Soft fabric design
features.text: Upholstered in premium fabric for a comfortable, cosy feel that’s perfect for your everyday meals.

features.title: Quilted mid-back design
features.text: The quilted backrest adds texture, elegance, and the support you need for those long conversations around the table.

features.title: Sleek, strong frame
features.text: Durable and stylish, the powder-coated metal frame keeps things stable while adding a sleek, modern edge to your space.

features.title: Supportive curved back
features.text: The curved backrest hugs your posture, offering lasting comfort so you can savour every meal.

features.title: Easy to assemble
features.text: Life’s busy—we get it. Flat-pack construction means hassle-free assembly and easy transport, so you can set up without the stress.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
